title: InterDesign York Bath, Boutique Box, Vanilla
text: InterDesign York Bath, Boutique Box, Vanilla. The quality is wonderful, but I wish it was smaller.  I liked the look and put it on my Sink Counter extension along with the cup holder.  After a while, it just seemed too  Bulky  sitting next to the Matching Cup-Holder.  I  keep it in my closet, and look for a neutral (Ivory-tan) Kleenex box instead.  I would like to return it, but I bought it quite a while ago, so I don't think that's possible, even though it is mint condition staying in my closet.
